::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 11th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Reading University Library 228/289
:::

[Sir](organizations/other_135.qmd)

I enclose £1.1 for the use of the poem on the Fireside.[^1]  I believe [Mr Ward](organizations/other_236.qmd) thought he had enclosed your note, and forgot to do so, and therefore I could not but be mortified at the refusal

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: ‘Pictures in the Fire’ by Adelaide Procter (1825-1864), whose hugely popular poetry was published by Bell.  The cheque for a guinea to G. Bell was debited on 16 April.  CMY was including the poem in an anthology published by Ward: *Aunt Charlotte's Evenings at Home with the Poets* (1881).
